thread:
acme_dev: Hey support — our app started getting 429s around 11:35 UTC and the dashboard shows our monthly credits at 0 even though we had ~120k left yesterday. We did a burst for a batch job last night but not enough to zero us out. Can you check?

Maya (support): Sorry you're hitting this, thanks for flagging. Can you paste the org id and approximate time range? Any recent changes to key rotation or new services hitting the API?

acme_dev: Org: org_0a1b2c3d. 11:30–11:40 UTC is when errors started. No key rotation. Our telemetry shows a single worker job started churn at 11:12 UTC that calls embeddings heavily — but we've had similar jobs before. Example error sample from client: `{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","message":"quota exhausted"}`

Maya (support): Copying in billing and oncall: @Arjun (billing) @Leo (eng-oncall) — can either of you look at quota accounting and recent resets for org_0a1b2c3d?

Arjun (billing): Looking. I see a monthly refill scheduled for the tenant timezone (Europe/Stockholm) on the 1st at 00:00 local. According to our ledger, there was a refill on 2026-02-01. For this org the billing window end is 2026-03-01 00:00 CET. Their credits show: start-of-cycle 500k, consumption 500k, current balance 0. I also see a pro-rata reconciliation adjustment at 2026-02-15 that deducted ~40k — investigating why.

Leo (eng-oncall): I pulled quota-service logs for org_0a1b2c3d around 11:10–11:40 UTC. There are many concurrent embed calls with ~65 tokens avg. There's also a background retry storm from one host (10.0.5.14) that started after a transient 502 from our upstream. That retry loop looks like it retried with exponential backoff disabled (bug). Example log snippet:

```
2026-02-22T11:12:05Z quota-service INFO check_quota org=org_0a1b2c3d remaining=45012
2026-02-22T11:12:07Z embeddings-proxy WARN upstream_502 req_id=abcd1234
2026-02-22T11:12:07Z worker-14 ERROR retry_loop exceeded max_attempts=120 sleep=0.1s
2026-02-22T11:12:07Z quota-service INFO deduct_tokens org=org_0a1b2c3d tokens=12000 new_balance=33012
... (repeats rapidly)
```

Leo (eng-oncall): That rapid loop caused ~300k tokens consumed in ~12 minutes. The retry behavior should have capped; looks like a recent change to the worker's retry wrapper removed jitter.

Arjun (billing): The pro-rata adjustment I mentioned earlier was from a tenant migration we ran on 2026-02-15 — we trimmed the credit bucket to align with new billing tiers and applied a one-time normalization. That explains the -40k. With the retry storm + migration trim, the math lines up to zero.

acme_dev: Hmm, interesting. The job shouldn't retry like that. Is there a way to confirm the 300k came from that host and get an audit so we can fix our worker?

Maya (support): We can provide per-key token logs — I'll pull the audit for the org for 11:00–12:00 UTC and mask any PII. Also we should validate that resets are applied in tenant timezone and visible in dashboard.

quota-bot: Automated note: billing-refill for org_0a1b2c3d scheduled at 2026-03-01T00:00+01:00 (CET). Next refill in 7 days. Current balance: 0 tokens.

Leo (eng-oncall): Action items from eng side: 1) patch worker retry wrapper to restore jitter and max backoff (PR in progress), 2) add a soft-rate-limit guard that will return 429s from the client rather than let workers retry infinitely, 3) provide per-host consumption export for support.

Arjun (billing): Billing action: reverse the incidental pro-rata trimming for this org as a one-time courtesy while they audit their job (will create a credit of 40k tokens) and flag account for manual review.

Sara (product): Quick thought — dashboard visibility: we should surface 'pending reconciliation adjustments' on the org billing view. Customer confusion is often because the UI shows only current balance without queued adjustments. Filing a follow-up feature request.

Maya (support): acme_dev — I'll send the per-key audit and confirm when the credit reversal posts (should show within 30 minutes). In the meantime you can re-run non-critical batches after we lift the block, or request a temporary burst increase if needed.

acme_dev: Thank you — please include the request id for the audit and any logs for the host so we can patch our worker. We'll also look at adding jitter. Appreciate the quick triage. :pray:

Maya (support): Request ids: audit_20260222_org_0a1b2c3d_1135 and quota_export_20260222_1145. Arjun — please confirm when credit reversal completed so I can close the ticket.

Arjun (billing): Reversal posted at 2026-02-22T12:03:47Z for 40,000 tokens. Noted: manual review scheduled.

Maya (support): Closing loop — acme_dev, let us know if you still see 429s after restart. Eng will follow up with the PR and a short postmortem on retry behavior. Creating internal follow-up thread for eng and product. :white_check_mark:
